about: The steps of the Translation Logbook that logbook.py cannot find for itself. A step of the plan is done when it has a date in done. The phase-3 step is measured from the key groups. An entry of log is shown in the log beside the key groups, newest first.

plan.name: Phase 1: the translations in the repository
The full run, and into basewithfixes and dev

log.title: The terms are settled
log.text: [terms.csv](terms.csv) gives each term of the application and its translation in each of the 26 translated languages: 505 lines, one translation in each cell. 8 terms with more than one sense have a line for each sense, for example "Leg (between two controls)" and "Leg (of a relay)". 34 lines that are not terms of the application came out. [terms-decisions.tsv](terms-decisions.tsv) gives each of the 4,152 decisions and its reason: 2,505 cells filled, 593 chosen from several, 868 corrected. The translator of each key group sees the key's terms in its packet.

log.title: Phase 2: the faults
log.text: The Include choice of the PDF and image export, which was English in all languages, is translated into the translated languages. The 22 errors that check.py found are corrected: placeholders that the English does not have, and braces outside a placeholder, which make string.Format throw. The review is [reviews/phase-2.md](reviews/phase-2.md).

log.title: Phase 1: the translations in the repository
log.text: The satellites of PurplePenCore's resources that upstream's TranslateTool left in src/PurplePen moved into src/PurplePenCore: 868 translations that the application did not show, in en-GB, it, sl, ru, ca and ku.
